photo_evidence_remaining.required: one in situ entire plant at soil level with 5cm ruler; show ascending shoots and root contact; no substitute from a cropped voucher
1mm scale + strong 10-30x magnification of opposite leaf junction; physically distinguish each 0.3–0.7 mm appendage from nearby hairs; label only confirmed attachment
macro with resolvable epidermal bumps, 30x or stereo scope if needed; show separate hair and papilla structures
intact mature 3-lobed capsule plus lateral dissected coccus of the same fruit showing the distal cavity; only if collecting permitted
released unequivocal 1-1.4mm seed in dorsal/lateral views with 1mm scale, not mixed loose debris; check cross sculpture
